compute_ssim_between_images: compute the structural similarity index between two PyTorch image tensors using the ssim function
compute_ssim_with_mask: compute the SSIM between two images using a mask to weight only specific regions of interest
create_gaussian_window: create a 2D Gaussian window kernel for a given window size and channel count using create_window
generate_gaussian_kernel: generate a normalized 1D Gaussian kernel tensor for a specified window size and sigma using gaussian
compute_ssim_per_sample: compute per-sample SSIM values by setting size_average to False to get individual scores per image
